title: Girl’s Podcast About Dyslexia Wins Big Prize
summary:
Cora Walsh is a seventh-grader from Long Island, New York. She won the middle-school grand prize in NPR’s Student Podcast Challenge.

Her podcast is called “Dyslexia and MEE.” It tells how she learned why reading was hard. Cora has dyslexia, a learning difference that can make reading tougher. She said it took almost five years to get the right diagnosis.

Nearly 1,500 podcasts were sent in from 42 states and Washington, D.C. Cora felt excited to win. Her mom, Emily Johnson, said she was proud of Cora’s hard work.

Cora has had tutoring for two years. She says she reads better now and likes it more. This summer she even read a Hunger Games book for fun. She hopes her podcast helps other kids who learn in different ways.
why_it_matters: Hearing a kid’s story about learning differences can encourage classmates who also struggle with reading.
